snippet.title: Fogpiercer - Announcement Trailer | Roguelite Deckbuilder On a Train
snippet.description:
In this roguelite deckbuilder, build and upgrade your train to expand your deck, fight off bandits on a square grid using unique carriage cards, where your final deck depends on the decisions you make in any given run.

➤ Wishlist Now on STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3219010/Fogpiercer/
